GraphLite.purpose: DYNAMIC language discovery via heuristics + parsing

tier1_extension_heuristic.mapping: .rs → rust .ts → typescript .js, .mjs, .cjs → javascript .svelte → svelte .jsx, .tsx → typescript .vue → vue (if grammar available) .py → python .go → go .java → java .kt → kotlin .rb → ruby .php → php .cs → csharp .swift → swift .cpp, .cxx, .cc → cpp .h, .hpp → cpp

tier3_parsing_validation.process: 1. Try grammar parse → success → confirmed 2. Parse errors → try next likely grammar from extension family 3. All fail → mark "parseable_unknown" + generic queries
tier3_parsing_validation.grammar_priority: typescript > javascript (for .js files) rust > cpp (for unknown C-like)

grammar_discovery_process.available_grammars: Scan ALL tree-sitter crates at runtime

flags.list-grammars: Show ALL discovered grammars + file matches

storage_enhanced.languages_table_dynamic: CREATE TABLE languages ( name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, grammar_crate TEXT, files_count INTEGER, parse_success INTEGER, confidence REAL, discovered_at INTEGER DEFAULT (unixepoch()) );

edge_cases_handled.unknown_grammars: parseable_unknown → generic symbol queries unparseable → file metadata only (size, modtime)
edge_cases_handled.grammar_missing: Skip file → log warning → continue No hard failure on missing grammar crate

GraphLite.Cargo.toml_grammar_dynamic:
# Core tree-sitter (grammar loader) tree-sitter = "0.22"
# Common grammars (fallback if dynamic load fails) tree-sitter-rust = "0.22" tree-sitter-typescript = "0.22" tree-sitter-javascript = "0.22" tree-sitter-svelte = "0.22"
# Dynamic grammar loader (runtime discovery) # tree-sitter-language-pack or similar
